title: People who say they worked on recovered craft

tellings.quote: I met people who claimed to have worked there or seen them.

plain: A researcher named Kevin Knuth, presented on Jesse Michels's podcast as a whistleblower about NASA, the US space agency, says he has met people in the United States who claimed to have worked on recovered craft, or to have seen them. He does not name them. If they are right, it would mean such craft are held somewhere and studied.
